# v0.30.2: the merged-reply loss fix

v0.30.2 is a patch release on v0.30.1 with one fix: an assistant reply that calls tools could be counted as stored without being stored. It changes no setting and no schema. Everything else in the [v0.30.1 notes](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/releases/tag/v0.30.1) still applies.

## Fixed

- **An assistant reply that calls tools is stored when its turn began with two unanswered user messages.** This was the first item under Known issues in v0.30.1.
  - Hermes merges two user messages in a row into one before the model call (for example, in a group chat, or when a second message arrives before the agent replies). The agent's first reply then sits before LCM-X's resume point.
  - v0.30.0 and v0.30.1 counted that reply as already stored without storing it. Its tool results were stored, and Hermes's own transcript still holds the reply. Conversation length did not matter.
  - LCM-X now checks the session's stored rows for the call ids of every tool call and tool result before the resume point that it has not already matched, and stores each one it cannot find.
  - That check has row, byte and id limits, and a read can fail. When it cannot finish, such a row keeps its credit only if the session's previous completed ingest held a row of the same kind with the same ids; every other such row is stored. When LCM-X cannot tell, it stores the row: a possible second copy instead of a possible loss.
  - [#3019](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3019), ported to main in [#3020](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/3020).

## Known issues

- **Replies lost before this release are not restored by it.** Hermes's own transcript still holds them. A repair planned for v0.30.3 can restore them while the transcript still holds them ([#3022](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3022)).
- **This release can store a second copy of a tool call and its result where v0.30.1 would not.** It needs the check above to stop before it finishes, and a call and result that LCM-X stored without their host timestamp, either on the first ingest after a restart or a session rotation, or after that call and result left the conversation and came back. Nothing is lost: recall can return them twice.
- **Rare shapes still lose or copy a tool call or result.** They need the check above to stop before it finishes, together with an unusual case, for example an oversized tool call that LCM-X ignores, a tool result whose id repeats, or a check that fell open on the previous ingest. A tool call whose id repeats or cannot be read also keeps v0.30.1's behaviour. In each shape, v0.30.1 loses or copies the same row. The nine shapes are tracked in [#3023](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3023).
- The other v0.30.1 known issues still apply, including a tool call that stays unstored when its result is already stored ([#3022](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3022)).

## Upgrade and rollback

- **Upgrade.** No setting changes and no schema change.
- **Rollback.** Take a SQLite-safe backup first (see `docs/operator-guide.md`). The rollback target is v0.30.1. Rows that v0.30.2 stored stay in the store as ordinary rows. After a rollback, the v0.30.1 known issues apply to that store again, the merged-reply loss included.

## Qualification

The fix changes the ingest audit, a storage path, so it ships on the careful lane, scoped to the fix's mechanism (release decision T1-482): the new tests and the targeted regression suites, without the full release campaign.
- `tests/test_merged_user_reply_loss.py` fails on v0.30.0, on v0.30.1 and on main before its port, and passes with the fix. Cells in `tests/test_topic9_loss_clause.py` and `tests/test_topic9_loss_cells_t1486.py` cover both routes of the loss. The fix's lane removed eight of its mechanisms one at a time, and each removal made a cell fail.
- CI on the fix's final commit ([run 44994888137](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/actions/runs/44994888137)) failed the same 9 of 36 jobs as v0.30.1's own commit ([run 44949714507](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/actions/runs/44949714507)). Lint fails on two unused imports in one test file. The eight test jobs fail on one compatibility test, which needs a v0.30.0 commit that the release line's CI does not fetch. Both are test and CI fixes tracked in [#3021](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/3021). The Real Hermes host and Differential workflows passed on that commit.
- Review: two independent reviewers, one Codex and one Claude, over three rounds. Round 3 found one regression: with redaction on, a redacted tool call that Hermes echoed back was stored again when the check stopped early. It was fixed, and both re-checks of that fix found nothing. The handling of ids that redaction rewrites is proven by code reading only: no test exercises the redaction path.
- Not run for this release, by the same decision: the full release campaign, including the real-store and benchmark rows.
